scope: Fletcher Insulation families represented by the 134 Fletcher-labelled rows in Sheet1
rating_scale: 1 = low relevance, 3 = useful, 5 = primary strength; ratings guide discovery and are not compliance or performance certificates

families.name: Pink Batts Wall Insulation
families.primary_function: Glasswool thermal insulation for internal and external residential wall cavities.
families.score_notes: Strong general wall-thermal fit. Soundbreak is the stronger Fletcher family when acoustic transfer is the primary problem.
questions: Is the wall internal or external?
What stud spacing and cavity depth are available?
What required material or total R-value applies?
human_gates: Select R-value and width from the actual wall system
Confirm climate-zone, condensation and NCC requirements
Do not use a batt rating as a complete wall-system rating

families.name: Pink Batts Ceiling Insulation
families.primary_function: Glasswool thermal insulation for residential ceiling applications.
families.score_notes: Primary Fletcher thermal family for ceilings; select by required R-value, available depth and regional product code.
questions: Is this a new ceiling or retrofit?
What existing insulation is present?
What R-value, joist depth and downlight clearances apply?
human_gates: Confirm current regional SKU and CodeMark coverage
Assess existing insulation and electrical clearances
Confirm total system R-value

families.name: Pink Batts Floor Insulation
families.primary_function: Glasswool thermal insulation for suitable suspended-floor applications.
families.score_notes: Thermal floor family; access, support and moisture conditions govern practical suitability.
questions: Is the floor suspended and accessible from below?
What joist spacing and depth apply?
Is moisture or exposed subfloor wind a concern?
human_gates: Confirm current TDS and available SKU
Verify retention/support method
Check moisture, services and subfloor conditions

families.name: Soundbreak Acoustic Insulation
families.primary_function: Higher-density glasswool insulation for reducing sound transfer through designed walls, ceilings and floors while also providing thermal resistance.
families.score_notes: Strong Fletcher choice when cavity absorption and thermal performance are both important; system construction controls the achieved Rw.
questions: Which wall, ceiling or floor construction is involved?
Is the noise airborne or impact noise?
What cavity depth and acoustic target apply?
human_gates: Do not present material R-value, NRC or alpha-w as Rw
Use tested system evidence for an acoustic target
Reconcile legacy 9021xx/4006068 codes before quoting
Confirm batt size, cavity depth and complete construction

families.name: Pink Partition Insulation
families.primary_function: Glasswool insulation for commercial internal and external partition systems across common steel-stud sizes.
families.score_notes: Commercial partition family with multiple densities and sizes; density alone is not an installed acoustic rating.
questions: What stud depth and spacing apply?
What wall system and acoustic/fire target is specified?
Is thermal resistance also required?
human_gates: Select density and thickness from tested/specifed system
Do not infer Rw from density
Confirm fire and project specification

families.name: FI32 Semi-Rigid Insulation
families.primary_function: Semi-rigid glasswool in sheet or roll form for internal duct lining, process equipment and acoustic baffles.
families.score_notes: Technical HVAC/industrial family with facing options; suitability depends on airflow, facing, temperature and system design.
questions: Is this internal duct lining or equipment insulation?
What thickness, facing and air velocity are specified?
What fire, hygiene and acoustic requirements apply?
human_gates: Confirm facing and exposure
Verify HVAC/fire/hygiene specification
Use current TDS for R-value and acoustic data

families.name: FI24 Flexible Ductliner
families.primary_function: Flexible glasswool roll for internal lining of sheet-metal ductwork.
families.score_notes: Purpose-made internal duct-liner family; the sheet's FI22 name needs code/TDS confirmation against the current FI24 range.
questions: What duct dimensions and internal lining detail apply?
What product code, facing, thickness and air velocity are required?
Is the sheet's FI22 record a legacy designation?
human_gates: Confirm legacy FI22-to-current-FI24 identity
Check facing, air velocity and hygiene requirements
Confirm current product code

families.name: Pink Thermal Slab
families.primary_function: Foil-faced semi-rigid glasswool board for commercial under-slab soffits, concrete floors, roofs and walls.
families.score_notes: Strong commercial soffit/under-slab family; facing, fixings and fire classification must match the installation.
questions: Is the application an exposed soffit, floor, roof or wall?
What R-value and fixing system are specified?
What lining/fire classification applies?
human_gates: Confirm fixing and facing detail
Retain exact fire-classification context
Verify project specification

families.name: Fletcher Protect / Fire Stop Party Wall Stonewool
families.primary_function: Stonewool batts, strips and foil-faced blanket for compress-filling nominated party-wall and separating-wall details.
families.score_notes: Specialist fire/acoustic family. Recommendation means use the Fletcher party-wall system family—not that a project detail is automatically compliant.
questions: Which tested party-wall system and junction is involved?
Is a batt, strip or foil-faced blanket specified?
What FRL/NCC detail and compression requirement applies?
human_gates: Follow the nominated tested system and installation guide
Confirm exact component code
No standalone compliance claim

families.name: Permastop Building Blanket
families.primary_function: Foil-faced glasswool building blanket for metal roofs and suitable wall systems, providing thermal insulation, condensation control and rain-noise reduction.
families.score_notes: Strong metal-roof thermal/condensation family with useful rain-noise benefit; blanket R-value and facing duty are SKU-specific.
questions: Is this roof or wall, and what cladding is used?
What R-value, blanket thickness and facing duty are specified?
What climate, condensation and BAL requirements apply?
human_gates: Confirm blanket compression and installed R-value
Select foil duty and roll size
Verify condensation, BAL and roof-system requirements

families.name: Sisalation Vapawrap Residential Wall Wrap
families.primary_function: Vapour-permeable water-barrier wall wrap for suitable cladding and climate-zone applications.
families.score_notes: Strong moisture-management option where a vapour-permeable wall membrane is required; climate and wall build-up govern selection.
questions: What climate zone and cladding apply?
Is a Class 4 vapour-permeable membrane required?
What UV exposure period is expected before cladding?
human_gates: Confirm vapour class and climate-zone selection
Seal laps and penetrations to the installation guide
Verify BAL/NCC edition and wall system

families.name: Sisalation Vapawrap Metal Roof
families.primary_function: Vapour-permeable roof sarking for condensation management beneath suitable roof cladding.
families.score_notes: Purpose-specific condensation-management membrane; it is not interchangeable with wall wrap or a vapour barrier.
questions: What roof cladding and pitch apply?
What climate-zone and condensation design apply?
How will drainage, laps and penetrations be detailed?
human_gates: Verify roof assembly and drainage detail
Confirm vapour-permeability requirement
Do not substitute wall-wrap SKU without evidence

families.name: Sisalation Tuff Wrap and Multipurpose Sarking
families.primary_function: Reflective pliable membranes for nominated wall and roof applications, helping manage radiant heat, water and draughts.
families.score_notes: Broad family for discovery only; exact Tuff Wrap or Multipurpose duty/class must be selected from climate, assembly and current TDS.
questions: Is the application a wall or roof?
Is vapour permeability or a vapour barrier required?
What duty, climate zone, water barrier and BAL requirements apply?
human_gates: Select exact membrane variant
Confirm vapour classification and duty
Verify BAL/NCC evidence for current product and edition

families.name: Sisalation Foam Cell and Bubble Cell
families.primary_function: Reflective composite membranes for suitable roof and wall systems, with selected Foam Cell products also serving as a thermal break.
families.score_notes: Practical reflective family; Foam Cell and Bubble Cell are distinct variants and must not share R-values or fire classifications.
questions: Is a thermal break, vapour barrier or sarking function required?
Is a Group Number required?
What roof/wall assembly and BAL requirement apply?
human_gates: Select exact Foam Cell or Bubble Cell variant
Keep product and total system R-values separate
Verify fire/BAL context

families.name: supaBATT External Wall Barrier
families.primary_function: Rigid glasswool external-wall board, available unfaced or with a Class 4 vapour-permeable facing.
families.score_notes: External-wall thermal family with faced and unfaced options; the broader wall/condensation design remains project-specific.
questions: Is the product being installed outside the frame?
Is the VP4 faced option required?
What wall R-value and condensation design apply?
human_gates: Choose faced or unfaced SKU
Confirm compatibility with adjacent membranes
Verify full wall system and NCC target

families.name: Fletcher Membrane Tapes and Thermal Break Accessories
families.primary_function: System accessories including Thermatape, Vapastop foil tape, plain foil tape and 3M seaming tape for their nominated parent systems.
families.score_notes: Accessory family only. Recommend the compatible accessory type after identifying the parent membrane or insulation system.
questions: Which parent Fletcher product is being installed?
Is the task a thermal break, foil seam or vapour-permeable membrane seam?
What width and exposure conditions apply?
human_gates: Confirm accessory compatibility
Thermatape compression changes R-value
Do not treat tape as standalone insulation

families.name: Safe'n'Silent Pro350 (legacy identity review)
families.primary_function: Three catalogue acoustic-batt records whose current Fletcher product identity could not be confirmed from the current product range.
families.score_notes: Not scored until the current identity and technical source are confirmed.
questions: Is this a discontinued or renamed Fletcher product?
Can purchasing confirm codes 4007197, 4007198 and 4007200?
Is a current TDS available?
human_gates: Do not recommend or quote until identity is verified
Do not automatically substitute Soundbreak

families.name: Sisalation FF HD facing roll (identity review)
families.primary_function: A single 500 m catalogue facing-roll record requiring confirmation of current name, application and technical data.
families.score_notes: Not scored until identity and intended parent system are verified.
questions: Is this a fabrication facing rather than installed insulation?
Can purchasing confirm product code 4008040?
Which parent system and current TDS apply?
human_gates: Do not recommend or quote until identity is verified
Do not infer membrane performance from the abbreviated name
